Hosted Ghost CMS: you pick a name and get a working site + newsletter + paid memberships "in 60 seconds" on your own domain. Migration from WordPress, Substack or Beehiiv is possible. Homepage pricing: self-serve hosting from 10 euros a month billed annually (12 euros monthly), 14-day free trial with no card, "hosted in the EU, GDPR compliant", 5.0 from 27 Google reviews. It says it is "built by an independent operator in London, no VC". The TrustMRR profile lists plans Solo 16 dollars a month, Pro 25 dollars a month, Studio 50 dollars a month billed annually. Target: "associations and communities, political parties and campaigns, and independent online media", ~45,000 estimated users.
